components.name: Input Field
components.description: Transparent input with ghost border, purple focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 0.933rem; background: transparent; border: 1px solid hsla(248 14% 83% / 1); border-radius: 6px; color: hsl(248 18% 16%); transition: border 0.2s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: hsla(248 12% 44% / 0.5); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: hsl(250 42% 52%); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px hsla(250 42% 52% / 0.18); }

narrative.northStar: Apple-level calm applied to a complex developer system
narrative.overview: Alice Studio is a testing orchestration platform dressed as a quiet operating system. Three character themes inhabit the same spatial framework but each carries a distinct temperature, rhythm, and material feel. Apple's core principles guide every surface: extreme clarity of hierarchy, strong visual breathing room, minimal visual noise, subtle depth through layering rather than borders, and content-first layouts where the UI disappears into the background.
keyCharacteristics: Three-character theme system: color, font, radius, animation tempo
Depth through translucent surface layering, not shadows
Typography-driven hierarchy with serif display / sans body pairing
Subdued ghost borders: structural hints, not design features

rules.name: The 10% Rule
rules.body: The primary accent color occupies no more than 10% of any given screen's surface area. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Ghost Border Rule
rules.body: Borders should be barely visible — a suggestion, not a declaration. If a border is the first thing you notice on a card, it's too strong.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Serif faces appear only in headings (h1–h4) and italic pull-quotes. Body text, labels, buttons, inputs, and navigation are always sans.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadows appear only as a response to state (hover, elevation, focus).

dos: Do use dark mode as the default and primary design surface
Do use the primary accent on ≤10% of any screen
Do use translucent layering in Alice theme only
Do let whitespace carry structure — 24px gaps between sections
Do use the timeline as the primary debugging tool
donts: Don't use Inter for everything — headings get serif in Alice and Soujuurou
Don't use pure black (#000) or pure white (#FFF) as backgrounds
Don't use thick borders (>1px) or colored border stripes
Don't use equal-weight card grids where every card demands the same attention
Don't use cyberpunk neon, cyan glow, or heavy glassmorphism
